description: Acceptance registered before host automation implementation. This is host protocol behavior, not an inferred CS-80 circuit law.

host_automation.keys: P_volume, P_mix, P_brilliance, P_resonance, P_masterTune, P_detune; CP_hpfCutoff, CP_hpfRes, CP_lpfCutoff, CP_lpfRes, CP_vLevel and CP_pw in both ranks, always referred to by enum name.
host_automation.vst3_truth: Steinberg IParamValueQueue: normalized piecewise-linear curves; previous block's last value is the implicit point at sample -1. A discontinuity is encoded by the old value at sample n-1 and new value at sample n. Preserve every queue point and all sample offsets, including first and last sample. Non-key parameters retain JUCE block-rate semantics.
host_automation.au_truth: Apple AudioUnitScheduleParameters: immediate changes at bufferOffset; ramps interpolate from startValue at signed startBufferOffset to endValue after durationInFrames, within the current render. Report scheduling capacity/invalid-input errors rather than silently dropping events.
host_automation.curve_windows: Evaluate independent scalar curves at every sample of 1, 7, 64, 256 and 1024 frame blocks: constant, ramp from implicit -1, several slope changes, consecutive-sample jump, first/last-sample event, negative-start AU ramp and constant tails. The same complete timeline split into these block sizes must preserve values and event timing.
host_automation.render_windows: Actual plugin processing compared against independently generated per-sample control frames with the same MIDI onset/release schedule. Compare one long host block with differently partitioned blocks; complete signal covers automation before and after note onset and both ranks. The VST3 test must exercise a built module through real IParameterChanges, not only an APVTS setter.
host_automation.compatibility: No-queue render must be byte-identical to the old block path. PURE CS-80 and Legacy retain last-point-at-block-start behavior byte-for-byte. Panel parameter automation must not bypass factory or memory source selection. Both engines receive effective changes in 16-voice mode.
host_automation.mutations: Drop an intermediate point, flatten offsets to zero, replace linear interpolation with hold, shift implicit origin from -1 to 0, drop last-sample point, remove Pure/Legacy isolation, bypass selected memory/factory authority. Each new gate must reject its corresponding implementation mutation.
